verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a meeting-notes SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of Granola; the API, MCP, CSV export and HIPAA material all describe access to Granola's own cloud service. Community posts only express a wish for self-hosted processing or point to other local tools, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
